ranked.why: A reproducible development environment gives every later implementation and test task a shared starting point.
The CI pipeline turns the test suite into a repeatable project-wide check instead of relying on each contributor to run it manually.
Coverage for critical modules reduces the risk of expanding the interface and supplies the checks the CI pipeline needs to enforce.
Review guidelines clarify how changes should be evaluated once automated checks are in place.
Public-facing documentation makes the project's workflows discoverable and gives new users a reliable setup path.
A feedback mechanism becomes most useful after users can install the project and understand its core workflows.
